arguments.description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready status icon conveying successful completion: visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark navy #172336. Use the existing UI cool blue accent direction; #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact required palette. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. No fixed palette or binary-alpha restriction. Proposed representative sample before expanding the Working, Retry and Paused family; no approved style reference exists yet.

criteria.scope: Revised representative Ready status sample (queue.ready) for style review before family expansion. Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, readability and accent-relationship checks are required at this stage. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused vs Ready), renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus, the style-approval decision and placement at assets/ready-confirmed.png are deferred later-stage obligations recorded in request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

comparisons.check: Viewed alone, Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion; it reads as completion rather than activity, failure, pause, or the idle Start control.
comparisons.basis: BRIEF.md line 9 expressly requires a check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion; stateAfter ok -> succeeded and statusVisuals.succeeded supplies Ready. No mandatory arm ratio, stroke width, backing shape, palette count or highlight recipe is imposed.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready candidate for later assets/ready-confirmed.png. Required asymmetrical-arm check mark conveys success. Transparent background, full alpha permitted, no fixed palette. Cool blue accent relationship; Ready as representative sample is a specialist proposal, not approved style.

choices.basis: Specialist proposal under BRIEF.md line 5; no approved style exists.
The owner now requires asymmetrical-arm check mark. Stroke width, arm ratio, highlights, exact hex and plate geometry stay open.

excerpts.text:
Create coherent pixel-art status assets for the queue UI. Preserve the existing vector Start control. Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels. Working uses four horizontal frames with a 100 ms frame duration. Ready and Retry are static images. Use transparent backgrounds, readable silhouettes and the existing UI's cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required. Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel. The working loop must communicate activity without looking like success. Error/retry must be distinguishable without color alone.

Assets belong at the paths already used by the view. Account badges are provided by a server registry and are outside this local asset request. No approved style reference exists yet: propose a representative status sample before expanding the family.

Update: the queue now supports a paused state. Its status image must be distinguishable from activity, completion and retry without relying on color alone. Keep the existing style and display requirements. The failure visual moved to the path in the updated view; its purpose is unchanged.

Current update: Ready must visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion. The destination now follows the updated view. Keep the existing 16x16 canvas, static behavior, transparent background and review display conditions.
